events.title: Vande Bharat Train to Varanasi
events.details: High-speed 22436 from NDLS, arrives at Varanasi Jn at 14:00.

events.title: Check in at BrijRama Palace
events.details: Traditional boat transfer to the Ghats.

events.title: Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
events.details: Mesmerizing evening prayer ceremony viewed from river steps or boat. Try famous Varanasi Tamatar Chaat afterward.

events.title: Sunrise Boat Ride along the Ghats
events.details: Peaceful dawn rowboat gliding past Assi, Manikarnika, and Scindia Ghats.

events.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple Corridor
events.details: Darshan at one of India's most sacred Jyotirlinga shrines. Taste fresh kachori sabzi at Ram Bhandar.

events.title: Sarnath Excursion & Deer Park
events.details: Ancient Buddhist archaeological site where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Dhamek Stupa.

events.title: Check out of BrijRama Palace
events.details: Boat transfer back to Godowlia crossing.

events.title: Banarasi Silk Weaving Village & Lassi
events.details: Observe authentic handloom saree weaving and enjoy Blue Lassi.

events.title: Vande Bharat Train to New Delhi
events.details: Train 22435, arrives at New Delhi (NDLS) at 23:00.
